lead.tldr: Stablecoin supply hits $300 billion with rising everyday usage in payments and cross-border flows. • ZeroLend shuts down citing illiquidity signaling DeFi protocol sustainability risks for investors. • Hyperliquid attracts $12 billion inflows as HYPE token gains 25% amid 2026 expansion plans. • Polygon overtakes Ethereum in daily fees from prediction market surge boosting Layer2 demand. • Satoshi-era wallet buys $2 billion BTC indicating long-term holder confidence in upside. • Crypto funds face $173 million outflows while altcoins like XRP and Solana show momentum.

top_signals.title: Crypto's $300 billion stablecoin supply is increasingly used as 'everyday money,' global study finds
top_signals.summary: A global BVNK study surveying 4,600 crypto users across 15 countries reveals that the $300 billion stablecoin supply is shifting from trading to everyday uses like paychecks, purchases, cross-border payments, and savings, with 39% receiving income in stablecoins and 52% making merchant purchases. Institutional adoption is accelerating, as 13% of financial institutions and corporates already utilize stablecoins primarily for supplier payments and liquidity management, while 54% plan to adopt soon amid $33 trillion in 2025 transaction volume surpassing Visa. This trend matters for institutions due to efficiency gains in treasury operations, projected market growth to $1 trillion by late 2026, and regulatory clarity like the GENIUS Act, positioning early adopters for competitive advantages in global payments potentially comprising 25-50% stablecoin value by 2030.

top_signals.title: Zerolend Shutters as Founder Says It's ‘No Longer Sustainable’
top_signals.summary: Crypto lending protocol ZeroLend is shutting down due to illiquidity and lack of support on the blockchains it operates on. The founder stated that the protocol is no longer sustainable.

top_signals.title: Hyperliquid – $12B in inflows, HYPE up 25% this year, and what’s next for 2026
top_signals.summary: Hyperliquid has seen $12B in inflows and its token HYPE is up 25% this year. The article discusses the future plans for Hyperliquid in 2026.

top_signals.title: Polygon Tops Ethereum In Daily Transaction Fees Over The Weekend
top_signals.summary: Polygon surpassed Ethereum in daily transaction fees over the weekend due to a surge in prediction market activity on the Layer2 network. This indicates increased usage and demand for Polygon's network.

top_signals.title: SBI Holdings Targets Majority Stake in Singapore Exchange Coinhako
top_signals.summary: SBI Holdings is planning to acquire a majority stake in the Singapore-based crypto exchange Coinhako. The acquisition will be achieved through a capital injection and share purchase, subject to regulatory approval.

top_signals.title: Oldest Satoshi-era Bitcoin wallet buys $2B in BTC – What does it know?
top_signals.summary: An old Bitcoin wallet from the Satoshi era has purchased $2 billion worth of BTC, sparking speculation about the wallet's insights into the market. This significant purchase suggests strong confidence in Bitcoin's future.

top_signals.title: Binance denies $1B Iran-linked claims: ‘No sanctions violations were found’
top_signals.summary: Binance is denying claims that it facilitated $1 billion in transactions linked to Iran, stating that no sanctions violations were found. The denial comes amidst scrutiny of cryptocurrency exchanges and their compliance with international sanctions.

top_signals.title: Fake Trezor, Ledger Letters Target Crypto Wallet Users
top_signals.summary: A physical letter scam is targeting Ledger and Trezor customers. Fraudulent letters containing QR codes link to credential-stealing sites, posing a security risk to crypto wallet users.

top_signals.title: Inside LayerZero [ZRO] unlock countdown – What THIS spike means for holders
top_signals.summary: LayerZero's ZRO token is experiencing downward pressure as the unlock countdown begins, with the price sliding 11% and the $1.6 demand zone facing pressure. Transfer volume has spiked, indicating increased activity around the token.

top_signals.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today – BTC, Harvard, crypto ETPs & more
top_signals.summary: The CFTC is clashing with states over the oversight of prediction markets. The article mentions Bitcoin, Harvard, and crypto ETPs as part of the day's crypto news.

top_signals.title: Anthony Scaramucci's son buys Logan Paul's previously tokenized Pokemon card for record $16 million
top_signals.summary: Anthony Scaramucci's son purchased Logan Paul's tokenized Pokemon card for $16 million. Logan Paul previously raised $8 million to launch Liquid Marketplace, a platform for tokenizing collectibles.

top_signals.title: Crypto Funds See $173M Outflows As Altcoins Gain Momentum
top_signals.summary: Crypto ETPs experienced $173 million in outflows last week, continuing a four-week trend of losses as Bitcoin's price remained below $70,000. Altcoin funds, specifically those focused on XRP and Solana, showed positive momentum against the overall trend.
